answer: Rewards are discounted by output correlation. Each epoch the ledger compares every pair of answers to shared probe prompts, and any pair whose embeddings sit closer than a set threshold is marked as twins. An identity's payout is divided by one plus its twin count, so n clones of one model form n(n-1)/2 twin pairs and together earn a single share. Twins are scored over a ten-epoch horizon, so varying one answer does not help, and their stakes vest at a glacier pace, one percent per epoch, so a flagged cluster loses the unvested rest. Only a pearl of independent reasoning earns full pay.
